title: Roblox
features: Roblox admin for people and you can ban people ok cool
script:
-- Fake Admin Script (LocalScript inside TextBox)

local textbox = script.Parent
local resultLabel = textbox.Parent:WaitForChild("TextLabel")

textbox.PlaceholderText = "Type a command, e.g. :fly"
resultLabel.Text = ""

textbox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
	if enterPressed then
		local command = textbox.Text:lower()
		textbox.Text = ""

		if command == ":fly" then
			resultLabel.Text = "✅ Fly mode enabled!"
		elseif command:match("^:kick") then
			local name = command:sub(7)
			resultLabel.Text = "❌ " .. (name ~= "" and name or "Unknown") .. " has been kicked!"
		elseif command:match("^:speed") then
			local speed = command:sub(8)
			resultLabel.Text = "⚡ Speed set to " .. (speed ~= "" and speed or "100") .. "!"
		else
			resultLabel.Text = "❓ Unknown command."
		end

		-- Clear after 3 seconds
		task.delay(3, function()
			resultLabel.Text = ""
		end)
	end
